Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [No response after rug pads ruined floors](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64ffb5d5b6b4eb87f3e02448)
In the past few months I have moved into a new home a purchased multiple new rugs and rug pads from L&G. We have come to discover that the standard rug pads have damaged our brand new hardwood floors. Our flooring professionals have seen this so many times and verified that it is the rug pad and not the floors or any other factors that caused this. It is due to chemicals on the pad. They were only on our floors for a month and we now have stains in the pattern of the rug pads. I have reached out to Lulu and Georgia to provide photos and to inform them of the horrendous quality items they are selling and have not even received a reply. At this point, the damage is done here but they shouldn’t be selling these products. I don’t want this to happen to anyone else.

September 5, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Sep 15, 2023

Hi Kristin,

Thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear about the issues with rug pads on your order. We have a representative currently working on your inquiry and providing feedback to our team for further review. If you need to add any further information on this, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
